title: bmo-pocket command
what: The bmo-pocket command: a tool put from a folder, a git address or a bare name, taken, or the registry listed; and the tool nouns listing, describing and calling a catalogue entry and reading the web namespace's site tools. Lives in host/src/install.rs, command.rs and bin/bmo-pocket.rs.

title: Tool registry
what: One pointer file per registered tool under the data root tool-host/registry, its keys in camelCase, naming the immutable version folder under tool-host/tools the host serves, written atomically under the registry lock. Lives in host/src/registry.rs.
